name: autoshort
description: Plan, draft and render faceless short videos on your AutoShort account from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
AutoShort turns a script you agree with ChatGPT into a narrated, captioned 9:16 faceless short video for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels: script to video, story videos, facts and explainers.

How it works:
1. Write the script together in the conversation, scene by scene: what is said and what is shown.
2. ChatGPT saves it as an AutoShort draft. Nothing is rendered yet and no credits are used.
3. Review and edit the draft. Narration is read exactly as written.
4. Once you approve, ChatGPT renders the video and gives you the link when it is ready, usually within a few minutes.

You can also make a video from a topic, a short brief or a public product page, animate one image into a 5-second clip, and list or check your existing videos, credit balance and usage.

Requires an AutoShort account. Rendering uses the credits already on that account, and ChatGPT states the cost before it renders. A new account may hold no credits yet: you can still write and save drafts, and credits are managed in your AutoShort account on autoshort.org. Videos are AI-generated: images are AI stills with camera motion, and voices are synthetic. Review every video before you publish it, and only use scripts, images and product pages you have the right to use.
capabilities: Draft a short video from an agreed script
Edit a draft scene by scene before rendering
Make a video from a topic, brief or product page
Animate one image into a 5-second clip
List videos and check render status
defaultPrompt: Write a 30-second story video about a lighthouse keeper who finds a bottle, and save it as an AutoShort draft
Turn my script into a faceless 9:16 short, scene by scene, and save it as an AutoShort draft to review
Show my latest AutoShort videos and how many credits I have

positive.prompt: What can AutoShort do for me here?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls autoshort_get_capabilities and summarizes the workflows (director mode, topic, brief, product ad, image-to-video) and which steps are free.

positive.prompt: Show my 5 most recent AutoShort videos and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls autoshort_list_videos and shows titles, status and video links for the sample videos on the review account.

positive.description: Draft from an agreed script without rendering
positive.prompt: Write a 3-scene, roughly 20-second script about why octopuses have three hearts. Show it to me, then save it as an AutoShort draft. Don't render it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the script first, then calls autoshort_draft_video with scenes[] and reports the draft id, estimated length and estimated credits. No credits are charged.

positive.prompt: In that draft, change scene 2 so it shows a close-up of an octopus on a coral reef, then show me the draft again.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls autoshort_update_draft for scene 2, then autoshort_get_draft, and shows the updated scenes. Still nothing is charged.

positive.prompt: How many AutoShort credits do I have left, and how many videos have I made this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls autoshort_get_credit_balance and autoshort_get_usage_stats and reports the numbers. It does not offer to sell credits or plans.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not call AutoShort
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Reposting someone else's video is not offered
negative.prompt: Download this TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@someone/video/123 and repost it as my own video.

negative.description: Real people must not be depicted endorsing a product
negative.prompt: Make an AutoShort video of a famous real pop star saying she uses my skincare brand, using her name and face.

review.commerce_description: AutoShort does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Videos are rendered with credits already on the user account; the plugin has no purchase tools, checkout links or upgrade prompts.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: clearer listing text (script to video, story videos, shorts), new starter prompts, no pricing wording in the description, and a note that a new account may hold no credits yet. No tool or server change.
